note: PROPOSAL ONLY -- NOT wired into the benchmark. These 31 hand-designed hard cases go to Siddhartha for approval first (slice 2, part A review gate). Wiring in is slice 2b, after he approves. Nothing in this file is read by the harness, the generator, or the manifest. Per case: question (or multi-turn script), primary family, expected behavior, oracle evidence computed directly from the 500K seed-42 data, why it is hard, and what the planner currently does (verified by probing plan()/ChatSession on 2026-11-05; 'passes' means the current behavior already matches the expected behavior, 'fails' means the case is a genuine finding). The 12 metric_scoping traps (h01-h12) are the highest-value group: 9 metrics silently return all-apps values for app questions, and 3 more hit the 'in <Month>' -> country IN tokenisation bug. For h01/h02/h04/h09/h12 the wrong-scope value is inside the harness 2% tolerance, so those cases can only be caught by a structural check (SQL must contain the app filter / must not contain a country filter the question did not ask for).
